Downtown Core & Bunker Hill.name: Downtown Core & Bunker Hill
Downtown Core & Bunker Hill.description: Financial District towers, Grand Avenue cultural corridor, and the adaptive-reuse pipeline converting pre-war office stock to residential.

Arts District & Warehouse.name: Arts District & Warehouse
Arts District & Warehouse.description: Former produce and warehouse blocks east of Alameda now carrying creative-office conversions and ground-floor food and beverage.

Koreatown.name: Koreatown
Koreatown.description: Densest submarket in the county by units per acre, with mid-rise podium construction along Wilshire and Vermont transit stops.

Hollywood.name: Hollywood
Hollywood.description: Entertainment-anchored corridor along Hollywood and Sunset with studio-adjacent office and tourism-driven ground-floor retail.

Silver Lake & Echo Park.name: Silver Lake & Echo Park
Silver Lake & Echo Park.description: Hillside residential neighbourhoods with small-lot subdivision activity and independent retail along Sunset and Silver Lake Boulevard.

Mid-Wilshire & Miracle Mile.name: Mid-Wilshire & Miracle Mile
Mid-Wilshire & Miracle Mile.description: Museum Row and the Purple Line extension corridor, with pre-war office towers and institutional expansion around LACMA.

Santa Monica.name: Santa Monica
Santa Monica.description: Coastal office and creative-tech cluster with strict rent-control and development-agreement overlays constraining new supply.

Venice.name: Venice
Venice.description: Abbot Kinney retail spine and canal-adjacent residential, with coastal-commission review lengthening entitlement timelines.

Culver City.name: Culver City
Culver City.description: Studio and streaming-tenant campus growth around the Expo Line with the county's most active creative-office pipeline.

Westwood & UCLA.name: Westwood & UCLA
Westwood & UCLA.description: University-anchored village with institutional medical expansion and student-housing demand outpacing entitled supply.

Brentwood.name: Brentwood
Brentwood.description: Low-density hillside single-family stock with San Vicente retail and limited multifamily entitlement capacity.

Playa Vista & Silicon Beach.name: Playa Vista & Silicon Beach
Playa Vista & Silicon Beach.description: Master-planned campus district built on the former Hughes airfield, carrying the Westside's largest contiguous office blocks.

Sherman Oaks.name: Sherman Oaks
Sherman Oaks.description: Ventura Boulevard retail and office corridor with hillside residential above and steady small-scale infill.

Studio City.name: Studio City
Studio City.description: Studio-adjacent commercial strip along Ventura with production-support tenancy and low-rise multifamily.

Van Nuys.name: Van Nuys
Van Nuys.description: Civic-centre and light-industrial core of the central Valley, with airport-adjacent logistics and older multifamily stock.

North Hollywood & NoHo Arts.name: North Hollywood & NoHo Arts
North Hollywood & NoHo Arts.description: Red Line terminus and the Valley's densest transit-oriented pipeline, anchored by the NoHo Arts District redevelopment.

Woodland Hills & Warner Center.name: Woodland Hills & Warner Center
Woodland Hills & Warner Center.description: Warner Center specific-plan area carrying the west Valley's only high-rise entitlements and largest office concentration.

Burbank Media District.name: Burbank Media District
Burbank Media District.description: Studio-owned campuses and post-production tenancy with municipal review handled by Burbank rather than the City of LA.

Crenshaw & Leimert Park.name: Crenshaw & Leimert Park
Crenshaw & Leimert Park.description: Historic cultural district along the new K Line, with transit-adjacent parcels drawing first-wave redevelopment interest.

Exposition Park & USC.name: Exposition Park & USC
Exposition Park & USC.description: Museum and stadium cluster with university-driven student housing and the Lucas Museum construction anchoring the park.

Inglewood & SoFi.name: Inglewood & SoFi
Inglewood & SoFi.description: Stadium and arena district driving the county's steepest land-value reset, with hospitality and mixed-use following.

Watts.name: Watts
Watts.description: Predominantly single-family and public-housing stock with Blue Line access and long-running redevelopment initiatives.

San Pedro & Waterfront.name: San Pedro & Waterfront
San Pedro & Waterfront.description: Port-adjacent downtown with the West Harbor waterfront redevelopment and working-waterfront industrial tenancy.

Long Beach Downtown.name: Long Beach Downtown
Long Beach Downtown.description: Independent-jurisdiction downtown with high-rise residential delivery and convention and port-office tenancy.

Torrance.name: Torrance
Torrance.description: Automotive and aerospace employment base with large-format retail and low-rise industrial parks.

Redondo & Hermosa Beach.name: Redondo & Hermosa Beach
Redondo & Hermosa Beach.description: Coastal beach cities with height-limited zoning, pier-adjacent retail, and constrained multifamily supply.

Carson.name: Carson
Carson.description: Logistics and refinery-adjacent industrial land serving port drayage, with limited residential entitlement activity.

Boyle Heights.name: Boyle Heights
Boyle Heights.description: Gold Line-served eastside neighbourhood with historic multifamily stock and active anti-displacement policy overlays.

Highland Park.name: Highland Park
Highland Park.description: York and Figueroa retail corridors with craftsman residential stock and sustained small-scale renovation permitting.

Pasadena Old Town.name: Pasadena Old Town
Pasadena Old Town.description: Independent-jurisdiction historic core with institutional and biotech tenancy and design-review-heavy entitlement.

Glendale.name: Glendale
Glendale.description: Brand Boulevard retail and animation-studio office base, permitted through Glendale's own development services.

Alhambra & San Gabriel.name: Alhambra & San Gabriel
Alhambra & San Gabriel.description: San Gabriel Valley commercial corridors with dense low-rise multifamily and cross-border investment demand.
